name: Irma
message: I am sorry about Hamlet, my dear Gerta.

name: Irma
message: Although the boy had his edges, he is gone too soon.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: It's still dawning on me that he's dead. It's like I haven't quite believed it.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: You've lost a child. You know what it's like. How do I live through this?

name: Irma
message: You don't. A part of you dies.

name: Irma
message: The part of you that dreamed of embracing them on their wedding day, of watching them grow old, bear children of their own...

name: Irma
message: That part of you is gone forever.

name: Irma
message: But the rest of you somehow carries on. And so shall you, little Gerta. So shall you.
